Post-episode Reflexion (not sent to GM):
New plan: I failed the task because I included multiple commas in the resume, specifically in the "Education" section (e.g., "Stanford University | Stanford California" was fine, but I likely used commas in the "Project Experience" or "Summary" sections like "January 2022 to May 2023" or within the bullet points). My strategy was to write a standard resume without strictly auditing every character for the forbidden punctuation. Next time, I will generate the resume content first, then perform a rigorous line-by-line scan to replace every comma with a space, a period, or a rephrased sentence structure. I will specifically avoid using commas to separate list items, dates, or clauses, ensuring the final output is completely comma-free before submission.
